# QR and code formats v1 (docs/ANDROID_BLE_DESIGN.md section 7.1). Generated by
# tools/gen_qr_formats_v1.py (Python standard library: hashlib SHA-256 and integer base32 only).
# Label encoding cross-checked against firmware/tools/provision_dev_secrets.py: yes.
# All values are visibly synthetic TEST data, never real secrets.

# Crockford alphabet 0123456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ, MSB first, zero pad bits at the end.
# Records (bytes "x:<hex>", "-" empty; text values never contain spaces, '_' marks a space in
# manual-entry inputs):
#   label_ok      device_id code label: the canonical setup label for a 16-byte setup code
#   label_entry   input -> device_id code: manual-entry normalization (case-insensitive, I/L -> 1,
#                 O -> 0, '-' and spaces ignored in the code part; device ID hex in either case)
#   label_bad     input reason: must be refused (reason names the first failing rule)
#   invite_ok     fields, payload (79 bytes), qr text (DSP2I1:<127 chars>), device_id_hash expected in HELLO
#   invite_bad    input reason: must be refused; reason 'unsupported' = version not 1 ("update the app")
#   invite_time   created expires now expect: ok | expired (now > expires + 120) |
#                 clock_warning (created > now + 300, still usable) | invalid (span rules)
